title: Fix pi-goal continuation abort lifecycle
description: Reproduce and fix pi-goal continuation failures and Error: This operation was aborted with minimal lifecycle changes. Add focused regression coverage and run full checks.

logs.msg: Reproduced the abort race in the adapter: Pi can deliver a follow-up after user input or user-owned lifecycle superseded its dispatch; message_start then called ctx.abort(), which aborted the user's run/queued work. Track user-superseded dispatch IDs and let Pi drain those stale queued messages instead of aborting. Added regression coverage. Verification: bun test 47 passed / 126 expectations; bunx tsc --noEmit; git diff --check.
